kzce01.title: Three Days, Then a Meme
kzce01.caption:
Three days on read, then a frog meme. The court was not amused.
A meme says hi. A reply says I saw you. Who in your chat replies in memes only?

kzce02.title: The Pros and Cons List
kzce02.caption:
Eight pros, one con, and the con is just nerves.
The court rules it's time to send the text. Who else has a list like this in their notes app?

kzce03.title: The Cozy Ex
kzce03.caption:
Going back to the ex because it feels like a warm blanket: very relatable, says the jury.
Missing them is allowed. Moving back in is a different question. Tag the friend who needs this verdict.

kzce04.title: The One-Letter Essay
kzce04.caption:
One letter, four paragraphs of feelings underneath.
The court can't read minds, so say the essay out loud. Which sign in your life texts like this?

kzce05.title: One Coffee, Zero Venues
kzce05.caption:
One coffee and Cancer already named the cat.
Hope is not a crime, but maybe enjoy coffee number two first. Who's the fastest planner you know?

kzce06.title: The Case of "Soon"
kzce06.caption:
"Let's hang soon" was said in December. It is now spring.
The court requires an actual day and time. What's the longest a "soon" has lasted in your life?

kzce07.title: Forty Minutes of "I Don't Mind"
kzce07.caption:
Forty minutes, two menus, zero decisions, and both of them are guilty.
Someone has to pick. Are you the picker or the "I don't mind" in your relationship?

kzce08.title: Feelings, Scheduled
kzce08.caption:
Capricorn booked the feelings talk for next quarter, with an agenda.
They said "how about tonight?" and the court agreed. Who in your life schedules their emotions?

kzce09.title: "Haha, Interesting"
kzce09.caption:
Someone said "I like you" and got "haha interesting" back.
If you need a minute, say you need a minute. Which sign would actually send this?

kzce10.title: Cried on the First Date
kzce10.caption:
Pisces cried twice on a first date: once at dessert, once at a dog.
The date called it the best date ever, and the jury cried too. Case dismissed with tissues.

kzce11.title: Reflection in the Sunglasses
kzce11.caption:
Fixing your hair in your date's sunglasses while they tell you about their grandma.
The court saw everything. Look at them, not the lenses. Which Leo do you need to send this to?

kzce12.title: Ninety Seconds, Three Texts
kzce12.caption:
hi. hiii. did that send?? All inside ninety seconds.
Excitement isn't a crime, but one text and then waiting is a skill. Who's your fastest triple-texter?

kzce13.title: The People v. The Group Chat
kzce13.caption:
One text said "sure." The group chat analysed it from 9 PM to 3 AM.
The answer was "sure! saturday?" Is your group chat the jury or the defendant?

kzce14.title: Single at the Holiday Dinner
kzce14.caption:
"So, seeing anyone?" was asked four times before dessert, and the question was found guilty.
Ask about the pottery class instead. Who's bracing for this at dinner this month?

kzce15.title: Six Months of Mutual Pining
kzce15.caption:
Two diaries, the exact same page, six months of nobody saying a word.
The sentence: one of you goes first. Have you ever been on the same page and not known it?

kzce16.title: The Trial of Playing It Cool
kzce16.caption:
Three weeks of "maybe" and "lol" while secretly liking someone. A full trial, with a surprise witness.
Stay for the verdict, and the sign in the gallery. Who's the coolest pretender you know?

kzce17.title: The Case of the Early Dog
kzce17.caption:
Aries suggested getting a dog together on date three, and already picked forty names.
Is fast a crime? The court checks in, and the ending has a twist with four paws.

kzce18.title: The Advice Giver
kzce18.caption:
Virgo gives perfect advice to everyone and takes none of it. Full trial, surprise witness included.
The sentence is the best part. Tag the friend who needs to hear their own advice.

kzce19.title: Thriving (Allegedly)
kzce19.caption:
Posting "thriving" every day after a breakup, plus the 2 a.m. scroll. The court has questions.
Healing is allowed to be slow, and Pisces has a hug ready. Who checks on you on the slow days?

kzce20.title: The People v. The Situationship
kzce20.caption:
Five months, inside jokes, a toothbrush at their place, and still no label.
The court orders the talk, and the fog finally clears. Ever been in one of these?
